courses.note: Elective: no operating systems or security course is strictly required. The Secure Computing Requirement is met by choosing one course from a list (including CSDS 344), and CSDS 344 and CSDS 338 are both breadth electives; CSDS 344 chosen because it is the security course on that requirement list. The only hit was an undated syllabus upload on a third-party document-sharing site (collegesidekick.com), blocked (HTTP 403 / Cloudflare) and not an official source, so it was not collected. No official public syllabus found.
